name: Рыжая курьерша · шлем-пузырь
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: character design concept sheet for the original game Orbita. Exactly one ADULT YOUNG WOMAN space courier and one OWL PET WEARING AN ENCLOSED SPACE HELMET. Must read as actual LOW POLY 3D game models: broad visible polygon planes, hard angular silhouettes, flat shaded surfaces, very simple solid color materials. No detailed textile textures, no individual feathers, no glossy Disney/Pixar toddler faces, no huge anime eyes, not photoreal, not painterly. Restrained face and elongated stylized body like a small puppet-like adventurer, appealing but practical adult woman in full coverage courier work clothes. Warm peaceful mood, no horror. Own original design; no yellow raincoat or paper bag head. Owl is visibly an owl with a heart facial disc, beak, folded geometric wings and two feet. Helmet MUST be a functional enclosed transparent dome or visor surrounding its entire head, attached to a visible collar seal, with tiny side oxygen fittings; owl face plainly visible through glass, no opaque face mask, NO just goggles or hat. Low-poly glass may use a few broad polygon facets, restrained reflection. Warm cream plain studio background, amber key light and terracotta shadows. Landscape sheet, main full-body three-quarter pair large at left, smaller matching side and back studies at right. Keep whole bodies and helmets inside frame. No text except the variant number. Variant "01". Young adult woman, short angular auburn bob and subtle friendly small-featured face. Cropped burnt-orange work jacket, oatmeal high neck, dark brown cargo trousers, sturdy oversized boots, insulated square delivery shoulder bag. Clear feminine silhouette without sexualization. Owl has ochre-brown body and warm ivory face; round clear faceted bubble helmet with chunky ivory lower collar and copper side pods, a single gold star on wing. Classic retro space postal service mood.
